name: NGC 4589, SN 2005cz field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4589, an elliptical galaxy that hosted SN 2005cz, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2005cz-hubble
story: NGC 4589 is an elliptical galaxy, thought to be the remnant of a merger, that hosted SN 2005cz, a peculiar fast and faint calcium-rich Type Ib supernova. Hubble came here hunting the massive stars that explode as core-collapse supernovae.

claims.text: NGC 4589 is a merger-remnant elliptical that hosted the calcium-rich Type Ib SN 2005cz
The program aimed to identify the massive-star progenitors of core-collapse supernovae
